      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "Standalone libbitcoin_consensus build breaks because AssertUnreachable introduces an unwanted dependency from interpreter.cpp into util/check.cpp",
      "quote": "calls assertion_fail from util/check.cpp. This file is in libbitcoin_consensus, which should only depend on crypto. Normal builds hide it, bitcoin_common pulls util in anyway, but the riscv job links ",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",

      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,

      "status_by_quote": "thx, excluded for now"
    },
    {
      "id": "rc:3887230883",
      "part": 1,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "correctness",
      "text": "The assert_falsy linter regex misses falsy assertions with variable whitespace or 0&&\"x\"",
      "quote": "The message says any falsy literal, but the regex hardcodes the spacing, so assert (false), assert(false ) and assert(0&&\"x\") all slip through.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "fixed",
      "status_note": "author adopted suggested regex",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611212"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": true,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3901611212",
      "status_by_quote": "Thx, used that."
    },

      "id": "rc:3887230883",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "Catch compiler-specific __builtin_unreachable() in the linter in addition to std::unreachable",
      "quote": "Worth catching the builtin too?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author explained risk is low for compiler-specific built-ins",
      "author_replies": [
        "rc:3901611212"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "rc:3901611212",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the risk of someone using it should be low, because it is a compiler-specific built-in."
